title: Convexo Protocol
tagline: Institutional Digital treasury to manage frictionless the real world reserves of the future
description:
We have 5 modules: Profile, Funding and Payments and SER.
- Home, shows the wallets, smartwallet with gas sponsorship  for embedded if he wants to use it whenever they want - some users want to have their keys.. We suggest smart wallets by default.
- Profile, users can get verified in 5 minutes using verify  can manage their private information like name, email and bank accounts.
- Funding allows users to charge their accounts with fiat in two ways, for lower 1000 usdc use via coinbase and higher than 1000 via OTC orders with account managers. Here Users can get  USDC and EURC or local stablecoins (COPe). We use Coinbase API
- Clients and Suppliers, is a CRM where they can save clients information from clients and providers to create and attach bills to them. 
- SER, we allow users to swap their digital assets via Uniswap V4 Liquidity Pools.
